reconciliation.issue: 13 unnamed columns and 159 fully-empty rows left by the Excel export
reconciliation.resolution: dropped as export padding; no populated row lost

reconciliation.issue: 16 unnamed columns and 159 fully-empty rows left by the Excel export
reconciliation.resolution: dropped as export padding; no populated row lost

reconciliation.issue: dates are DD/MM/YYYY with unpadded parts ('1/7/2025'); every other file is YYYY-MM-DD
reconciliation.resolution: parsed day-first explicitly so 1/7/2025 reads as 1 July, not 7 January

reconciliation.issue: region typed free-hand: 16 distinct spellings including 'EAST', 'East', 'East Region', 'NORTH'
reconciliation.resolution: case-folded and the ' Region' suffix stripped, to the 4 canonical names in dim_geo

reconciliation.issue: the stock-out log carries its own region, which can disagree with the distributor's territory in the masters
reconciliation.resolution: dim_geo via dim_distributor is authoritative; the logged region is kept only as a fallback (0 rows disagreed)

reconciliation.issue: sales are weekly by SKU x territory; targets are monthly by brand x region
reconciliation.resolution: sales rolled up to brand x region x month (dim_sku for brand, dim_geo for region; a week belongs to the month containing its week_start, per the data dictionary) before any comparison

reconciliation.issue: the stock-out log names the product column `item_code`; the master calls it `sku_code`
reconciliation.resolution: joined as the same key; 520 of 520 rows resolve to a known SKU

reconciliation.issue: the promotion calendar names the product column `sku`
reconciliation.resolution: joined to `sku_code`; 40 of 40 promotions resolve to a known SKU

playbook.condition: A brand misses target in a region (achievement < 70%) AND its SKUs have repeated stock-outs there
playbook.action: Expedite replenishment and escalate to the regional supply lead

playbook.condition: A brand misses target (< 80%) while a promotion is running with weak uplift (< 10%)
playbook.action: Review promo effectiveness with the brand team

playbook.condition: A brand misses target (< 80%) with NO stock-out and NO promotion in the period
playbook.action: Commission a market-visit / competitor check for the brand in that region

playbook.condition: A single distributor is out of stock for more than 6 weeks on a SKU
playbook.action: Raise a replenishment order for that distributor

playbook.condition: A brand over-delivers against target in a region (achievement > 110%)
playbook.action: Capture what worked and redeploy field effort elsewhere

playbook.condition: A brand misses target with no stock-out, no promotion, and no supporting note
playbook.action: Flag for manual review; do not auto-attribute a cause
Consider extending or replicating the mechanic in a comparable region

playbook.condition: A distributor shows stock-outs across 3 or more SKUs in a month
